items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: Like I’ve done stuff for Liza Minelli over the years.

ctx.x: They write the skeleton kind of?

The skeleton of it all, and then you give it to the orchestrator, and some of these orchestrators you never heard of, who are not only fabulous but that’s also a very lucrative — the only bad part for me would be it’s like being buried under something else you know. So I was never inclined to do that end of it. Over the years you establish a price for yourself basically. And there’s no — a lot of times an arranger starting out, he says well how should I charge? I said well you know what you do? Go to your Local —…
Yeah, you’re thinking about the people in that band playing your music for one thing.
